# Mary Li Art

> Portfolio and commission platform for Live2D animation and VTuber model creation services.

Mary Li Art specializes in custom commission work for Live2D animations and VTuber character models. The site provides information about services, pricing, and commission workflows while maintaining transparent privacy and legal policies.

## Key Topics

- Live2D animation
- VTuber models
- Commission services
- Custom art
- Pricing information
- Commission workflow
- Contact methods
- VGen
- Discord
- Twitter
- Terms and conditions
- Privacy policy
- GDPR compliance
- Data protection
- Google Analytics
